thresholds._comment: percentile mode self-calibrates: the top slice of each scan earns a directional call, so the ledger always gets falsifiable predictions to learn from. absoluteFloor stops it calling long on the best of a bad field.

social._comment: Social provider for the attention pillar. Rate-limited, so only the top `enrichTopN` tokens by composite get a lookup. Set LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY in .env to activate.

adapt._comment: Self-adaptation. `node run.mjs adapt` regresses graded outcomes against the feature vector and writes data/adapted_weights.json. Nothing is applied until apply=true.

telegram._comment: Channels as agents: every call is logged to the ledger as tg:<channel>, graded by the same grader, and ranked in the same scorecard. mode: public (no auth, PUBLIC channels only) | bot (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, bot must be channel admin) | mtproto (TELEGRAM_SESSION, sees everything your account sees).

predict._comment: Bootstrapped ranking + volatility forecasting. Ranks are re-run under perturbed weights so a top slot that only survives a third of the re-weightings is reported as unstable rather than as a call.

regime._comment: LAYER 0 - macro. EODHD free plan is 20 calls/DAY and batching bills PER SYMBOL (verified), so this defaults to SOL alone on a 90-minute floor (~16 calls/day). Add BTC-USD.CC only on a paid plan. Needs EODHD_API_KEY in .env.

aura._comment: AURA POINTS - a 2-3 hour trend-continuation score, deliberately a different question from FOMO. FOMO is ignition; Aura is fuel. Scored from GeckoTerminal candles (free, no key) for the top `candleTopN` by composite.

rugclock._comment: Rug pressure as a COUNTDOWN, not a property. Static contract risk is read once; this tracks liquidity trajectory over time, because the observed pattern is: attention arrives -> LP is attracted -> once the pool is worth stealing, it is pulled.

horizons._comment: Horizon board: separate reads for 5-10min (ignition), 1-5h (durability) and 1-10d (SURVIVAL SCREEN, not a forecast - there is no validated multi-day signal here). Each brief is archived to data/briefs so the board accumulates a track record.

agents._comment: The paid panel. Runs only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set AND a token crosses the promotion gate. Tune promoteScore/deltaThreshold/staleMinutes to trade cost against coverage.
